## About
Florida Nu Finish Collision is a full-service auto body repair facility on S Falkenburg Rd in Tampa, serving drivers from Tampa and Brandon. We repair all makes and models, from full collision and reconstruction to paintless dent removal.
Structural repairs are checked against manufacturer specifications on a computerized measuring system, and our technicians are trained by I-CAR. In the paint shop we use a P.P.G. computerized paint mixing system and downdraft booths so the finish matches the factory color.
Body and paint repairs carry a lifetime warranty for as long as you own the vehicle. A reviewer wrote that Allie and Mike are top notch. We hold a 4.2 rating from 245 Google reviews.

## Services
- Full collision and reconstruction: Structural and body repair for all makes and models, restored to pre-accident condition.
- Frame and unibody straightening: High tech straightening equipment used to bring the car back to factory specifications.
- Paint matching: A paint matching system that matches color for your make, model and year, with parts removed for painting and blending that hides the repair.
- Paintless dent removal: Dent repair without repainting the panel.
- Hand painted pinstripes: Pinstriping done by hand as one of our cosmetic services.
- Insurance Claims Experts: We know how, who and when to contact your insurance claims department, and we guide you from the first report of the claim through final delivery.
- Free vehicle pickup and delivery: We can pick your vehicle up and bring it back to you.
- Complimentary shuttle service: A ride to local destinations while your vehicle is in the shop.

## FAQ
Q: Can you help with my insurance claim?
A: Yes. Our staff are experienced and trained in insurance claims handling, and we will explain each step along the way.

Q: Is there a warranty on the work?
A: Yes. We offer a lifetime warranty on paint and repairs.

Q: Can I bring my car in outside regular business hours?
A: Yes. Call us and we can arrange an off hours appointment.

Q: Do you work on my make and model?
A: We repair all makes and models.
